<style>
.hist-root{min-height:360px}
.hist-shell{
  display:grid;
  gap:10px
}
.hist-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px
}
.hist-head h2{
  margin:0!important
}
.hist-tabs{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:5px
}
.hist-tabs button{
  min-height:32px!important;
  padding:6px 10px!important;
  font-size:8px!important
}
.hist-tabs button.active{
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:var(--pda-sea)!important;
  background:var(--pda-sea)!important
}
.hist-filters{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr auto;
  gap:7px;
  align-items:end;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.hist-filters .field{margin:0!important}
.hist-list{
  display:grid;
  gap:6px
}
.hist-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:130px minmax(160px,.8fr) minmax(180px,1fr) minmax(220px,1.4fr);
  gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:58px;
  padding:9px 11px;
  border:1px solid #e0dcd3;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.hist-row>div{min-width:0}
.hist-row strong{
  display:block;
  color:#2a4b56;
  font-size:8.8px
}
.hist-row small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#788681;
  font-size:7.4px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.hist-meta{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  color:#71807c;
  font-size:8px
}
.hist-more{
  justify-self:center
}
@media(max-width:1050px){
  .hist-filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .hist-row{grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 1fr}
  .hist-row>div:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .hist-head{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}
  .hist-filters{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .hist-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hist-row>div:last-child{grid-column:auto}
}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.HIST=(()=>{
  const {el,button,call,alive}=App;

  function date_(value){
    const d=new Date(value);
    return Number.isNaN(d.getTime())
      ?String(value||'')
      :d.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{
          day:'2-digit',
          month:'2-digit',
          year:'numeric',
          hour:'2-digit',
          minute:'2-digit'
        });
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;
    const shell=el('div',undefined,'hist-shell');
    const head=el('div',undefined,'hist-head');
    const copy=el('div');
    copy.append(
      el('h2','Histórico'),
      el('p','Consultas carregadas somente quando solicitadas.','hint')
    );
    const tabs=el('div',undefined,'hist-tabs');
    head.append(copy,tabs);
    shell.append(head);
    root.append(shell);

    const filters=el('div',undefined,'hist-filters');
    const search=el('input');
    search.type='search';
    search.placeholder='Buscar no histórico';

    const person=el('input');
    person.type='search';
    person.placeholder='Pessoa ou CPF';

    const user=el('input');
    user.type='search';
    user.placeholder='Usuário';

    const from=el('input');
    from.type='date';

    const to=el('input');
    to.type='date';

    const field_=(label,node)=>{
      const wrap=el('label',undefined,'field');
      wrap.append(el('span',label),node);
      return wrap;
    };

    const apply=button('Aplicar',()=>load_(0));
    filters.append(
      field_('Busca',search),
      field_('Pessoa',person),
      field_('Usuário',user),
      field_('De',from),
      field_('Até',to),
      apply
    );

    const meta=el('div',undefined,'hist-meta');
    const list=el('div',undefined,'hist-list');
    const more=button('Carregar mais',()=>load_(rows.length),true);
    more.classList.add('hist-more');

    shell.append(filters,meta,list,more);

    const labels={
      cadastros:'Cadastros',
      atividades:'Atividades',
      documentos:'Documentos',
      processos:'Processos'
    };

    let type='cadastros';
    let rows=[];
    let total=0;
    let hasMore=false;
    let seq=0;

    const render_=()=>{
      meta.replaceChildren(
        el('span',labels[type]),
        el('span',rows.length+' de '+total+' registro(s)')
      );
      list.replaceChildren();

      if(!rows.length){
        list.append(el('p','Nenhum registro encontrado.','hint'));
      }else{
        rows.forEach(item=>{
          const row=el('article',undefined,'hist-row');
          const when=el('div');
          when.append(
            el('strong',date_(item.data)),
            el('small',item.tipo||'Registro')
          );

          const who=el('div');
          who.append(
            el('strong',item.pessoa||'Sem cadastro vinculado'),
            el('small',item.cpf||'')
          );

          const actor=el('div');
          actor.append(
            el('strong',item.usuario||'—'),
            el('small','Usuário / responsável')
          );

          const detail=el('div');
          detail.append(
            el('strong',item.detalhe||'—'),
            el('small',item.id||'')
          );

          row.append(when,who,actor,detail);
          list.append(row);
        });
      }

      more.hidden=!hasMore;
      more.disabled=false;
      more.textContent='Carregar mais';
    };

    const load_=async offset=>{
      const request=++seq;
      if(offset===0){
        rows=[];
        list.replaceChildren();
        list.classList.add('is-syncing');
      }else{
        more.disabled=true;
        more.textContent='Carregando…';
      }

      const data=await call('historicoGeral',{
        tipo:type,
        busca:search.value,
        pessoa:person.value,
        usuario:user.value,
        de:from.value,
        ate:to.value,
        offset,
        limit:50
      });

      if(request!==seq||!alive(ctx))return;

      if(offset===0)rows=data.itens||[];
      else rows.push(...(data.itens||[]));

      total=Number(data.total||0);
      hasMore=!!data.hasMore;
      list.classList.remove('is-syncing');
      render_();
    };

    Object.entries(labels).forEach(([key,label])=>{
      const tab=button(label,async()=>{
        type=key;
        tabs.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(node=>
          node.classList.toggle('active',node.dataset.type===key)
        );
        await load_(0);
      },true);
      tab.dataset.type=key;
      if(key===type)tab.classList.add('active');
      tabs.append(tab);
    });

    [search,person,user].forEach(input=>{
      input.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
        if(event.key==='Enter'){
          event.preventDefault();
          load_(0);
        }
      });
    });

    await load_(0);
  };
})();
</script>
